en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a seafront promenade with traditional multi-story stone houses built along fortified walls descending to the water. A narrow coastal road follows the shoreline, and steps and ramps lead from the town down toward the sea. The architecture is typical of older Greek island settlements. Greek text captions appear below the image, along with a publisher's imprint and a watermark from an archive website.
